title: Electroencephalographic and convulsant effects of the delta opioid agonist SNC80 in rhesus monkeys
finding_used: 10 mg/kg IM gave behavioural convulsions and EEG seizures in 1 of 4 rhesus; 3.2 mg/kg gave neither; the convulsant dose was 3-10 fold above behaviourally active doses

title: Nasal Instillation of Complex Metal Oxide Particles Induces Brain Metal Accumulation and Neurobehavioral Toxicity in Mice
used_for: repeat intranasal dosing is not linear in brain accumulation
finding_used: low-dose exposure gave 5-17 fold higher brain bioaccumulation factors than high dose, i.e. disproportionate retention

title: Pharmacokinetic Modeling of the Nose-to-Brain Pathway as Demonstrated by Intranasal Administration of Cannabidiol-Loaded Nanoparticles
finding_used: intranasal bioavailability 47.9 percent; 56 percent of absorbed drug entered by the direct nose-to-brain route; brain bioavailability 28.5 percent vs IV; brain tmax 10 min

title: Delta opioid receptor agonists and seizure liability (review)
used_for: the liability is ligand-specific, not a class effect
finding_used: multiple delta agonists are reported not to cause seizures; the determinants are not understood

title: Delta opioid receptors expressed in forebrain GABAergic neurons are responsible for SNC80-induced seizures
finding_used: localises the SNC80 seizure mechanism to delta receptors on forebrain GABAergic neurons

title: Gene therapy for pain: results of a phase I clinical trial
used_for: clinical precedent for the payload class
finding_used: HSV vector expressing human preproenkephalin; no study-agent-related serious adverse events at any dose
